The APRA Music Awards of 2026 are the 44th annual series, known as the APRA Awards. The awards are given in a series of categories in three divisions and in separate ceremonies throughout the year: the APRA Music Awards, Art Music Awards and Screen Music Awards. The APRA Music Awards is scheduled to occur on 29 April 2026. Nominations for the Art Music Awards opened on 5 February to 25 February 2026.
The 25 songs shortlisted for Song of the Year were announced on 3 February 2026 with the final five nominees, alongside all genre category nominees for the APRA Music Awards, will be revealed on 31 March 2026.
